heading: Income gap multiplier
lead: For purposes of determining the income gap of a unit of general local government under section 6705(b)(4)(A),1 the number which applies is—

tree.text: 1.6, with respect to ½ of any amount allocated under section 6704 to the State in which the unit is located; and
1.2, with respect to the remainder of such amount.

notes.text: Prior ProvisionsA prior section 6706, Pub. L. 97–258, Sept. 13, 1982, 96 Stat. 1014, related to reductions in State government allocations, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 99–272, title XIV, § 14001(a)(1), (e), Apr. 7, 1986, 100 Stat. 327, 329, eff. Oct. 18, 1986.
